rationale: MSL and TileLang already provide two independent DSLs and three proven delivery/build/execution Tracks. Adding a third DSL only to satisfy a numeric target would add installation, isolation and evidence cost without new engineering value.
original_requirement: two MSL Tracks plus two new DSL Tracks
decision: narrow full MT6 to MSL + TileLang, subject to independent scope review; do not start a third DSL
